mechanism: Tranylcypromine may inhibit zidovudine metabolism via CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2C9 and CYP3A4), potentially increasing zidovudine concentrations and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for zidovudine toxicity (bone marrow suppression, neuropathy); consider zidovudine dose reduction or alternative antiretroviral agent if clinically feasible; ensure regular hematologic monitoring.
